description: Protection simulations of 7_cell_2000mAh, run by protection_simulate.py. Every test runs from a reboot; expect is the protection that must trip, in the segment marked expect_trip, and nothing may trip before it. Thresholds and times are those of config.json.

ovp_slow.description: Cell over-voltage slow (config 4230 mV / 2 s) on a full cell: 0.5 A (~4216 mV) no trip, 1.5 A for 1 s no trip, 1.5 A (~4250 mV) trips after 2 s

profile.note: about 4216 mV, below the limit: no trip
about 4250 mV for 1 s, shorter than 2 s: no trip

ovp_fast.description: Cell over-voltage fast (config 4280 mV / 200 ms) on a full cell: 3 A (~4300 mV) for 150 ms no trip, 3 A trips after 200 ms

profile.note: about 4300 mV for 150 ms, shorter than 200 ms: no trip

uvp_slow.description: Cell under-voltage slow (config 2700 mV / 5 s) on an almost empty cell: 15 A from 10 % SOC: the weakest cell falls below 2700 mV after about 17 s, UVP_SLOW about 5 s later (about 22 s)

profile.note: weakest cell below 2700 mV at about 17 s: UVP_SLOW at about 22 s

uvp_fast.description: Cell under-voltage fast (config 2500 mV / 500 ms) on an empty cell: 24 A from 3 % SOC: the weakest cell drops below 2500 mV at once, UVP_FAST 500 ms later (before UVP_SLOW at 5 s and OCP_DISCHARGE_SLOW at 10 s)

profile.note: weakest cell below 2500 mV at once: UVP_FAST after about 500 ms

ocp_charge.description: Charge OCP (config 6 A / 2 s): 5 A no trip, 7 A trips after 2 s

profile.note: over the limit: trips after 2 s

ocp_discharge_slow.description: Discharge slow OCP (config 16 A / 10 s): 14 A no trip, 22 A for 5 s no trip, 20 A trips after 10 s

profile.note: over the limit, shorter than 10 s: no trip
over the limit: trips after 10 s

ocp_discharge_fast.description: Discharge fast OCP (config 25 A / 200 ms): 30 A for 150 ms no trip, 30 A trips after 200 ms

profile.note: spike shorter than 200 ms: no trip
over the limit: trips after 200 ms

otp.description: Over-temperature (config 55 C / 5 s): 54 C no trip, 60 C for 3 s no trip, 60 C trips after 5 s

profile.note: just below the limit: no trip
over the limit for 3 s, shorter than 5 s: no trip
over the limit: OTP after 5 s
back to 25 C, FET held off

utp.description: Under-temperature (config -20 C / 5 s): -19 C no trip, -25 C for 3 s no trip, -25 C trips after 5 s

profile.note: just above the limit: no trip
under the limit for 3 s, shorter than 5 s: no trip
under the limit: UTP after 5 s
back to 25 C, FET held off

otp_charge.description: Charge over-temperature (config 45 C, otp_time_ms 5 s): 50 C at rest no trip, charging at 44 C no trip, charging at 50 C for 3 s no trip, charging at 50 C trips after 5 s

profile.note: 50 C but not charging: no trip (below OTP 55 C)
charging just below the limit: no trip
charging over the limit for 3 s: no trip
charging over the limit: OTP_CHARGE after 5 s
back to 25 C, FET held off

utp_charge.description: Charge under-temperature (config 0 C, utp_time_ms 5 s): -5 C at rest no trip, charging at 1 C no trip, charging at -5 C for 3 s no trip, charging at -5 C trips after 5 s

profile.note: -5 C but not charging: no trip (above UTP -20 C)
charging just above the limit: no trip
charging under the limit for 3 s: no trip
charging under the limit: UTP_CHARGE after 5 s
back to 25 C, FET held off
